name: Square POS
description: One stock and one order history for Square POS and your Swell store

images.title: One stock for shop and store
images.description: A sale, a delivery or a recount on either side reaches the other, usually within a minute.

images.title: Till sales in your order history
images.description: Each sale completed in Square becomes a paid order in Swell, on the customer's account when Swell knows the customer.

images.title: The receipt, to the cent
images.description: Lines, discounts and taxes are the ones Square charged, and the order total is what the customer paid.

images.title: Nothing guessed, nothing lost
images.description: What cannot be linked or imported is listed with the reason, and your administrators get one e-mail.

images.title: Set up in minutes
images.description: Paste your Square access token, match your products by SKU, and switch on what you need.
